# Kleynenberg Publishers (KP) — Catalogue Summary
> Canonical URL: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/kp/
> Publisher: Steven Kleynenberg (Delft, The Netherlands)
> Parent Index: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/llms.txt

## Overview
Kleynenberg Publishers (KP / naaap.io) is an independent Dutch publishing house producing digital books, historical monographs, broadsheets, and algorithmic music and cinema.

## Published Google Play Books Catalogue
1. Arps Fotoalbum: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=w5oBEgAAQBAJ
2. Bernardus Arps: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=V5gDEgAAQBAJ
3. Niet van Hergé - De Grappigste, Scherpste en Vreemdste Kuifje-Parodieën: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=bqgDEgAAQBAJ
4. GIGA! Garbage In, Garbage Out — Une Étude en Ordure et Lumière (2026): https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=gdf0EQAAQBAJ
